rows.etymology: 5054 CHUP 'touch'. [Derivation by P. Tedesco Or. Lit. 1932, 534 < sśr̥p- metath. of spr̥ś- receives some support from the Pk. variants chuvaï, chivaï, chavēi. But more prob. it is a deriv. (with generalized ch-) of *sqeup- in OEng. sceofan, scufan and Khot. (S. Konow, Saka Studies 181) sku- 'to touch', skuta 'touch' if < *squp-, *squpti-. — For list of poss. enlargements of IE. *sqeu- see √sku]
